messages:
Anna Chen: Quick thread — I ran a focused bench for the new 30B family using our q4_0/fp4x4 quant packs across three regions (us-west h100, eu-central a100, ap-southeast h100). Sharing the short summary and asking for Dedicated sizing guidance + kernel fallback plan. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

bench-bot: Raw summary (tokens/sec, p50, p95 lat ms) — small prompt (64 tokens), batch=1:
```
us-west/h100-q4: tps=55, p50=18ms, p95=42ms
eu-central/a100-q4: tps=38, p50=26ms, p95=68ms
apac/h100-q4: tps=47, p50=21ms, p95=55ms
```

Anna Chen: note — q4->q4f32 fallback shows p95 jump ~1.6x on a100 due to kernel mismatch. Also warmup KV hit rate matters for longer contexts.

Josh Patel: Thanks Anna. From these, for a target 99th latency SLO of 100ms and target sustained concurrency of 40 requests/s (client-level), my quick sizing:
- us-west (h100): start pool with 4 GPUs, reserve burst + warm pool of 1 extra.
- eu-central (a100): start with 6 GPUs (lower tps), reserve 2 for spikes.
- apac (h100): start with 5 GPUs, reserve 1 for burst.

These assume continuous batching enabled with max_concurrency_per_gpu=16. :memo:

Priya Rao: Add ops note: set autoscale headroom to 0.45 for eu (multi-az variance) and 0.3 for us/apac. That keeps p95 risk low during uneven traffic. Also enable quicker warmup for 30B (keep a small warm slot). :gear:

Marco Silva: Kernel observations — flash_attn kernels on H100 give best p50 but q4 packing needs triton kernels we haven't fully validated on a100. Recommend config: prefer flash_attn on H100, fallback order -> triton_fwd -> reference. If fallback to fp32 path, enable graceful throttling to avoid p95 blowups.

Marco Silva: Example pool config suggestion:
```yaml
pool_name: 30b-quant-dedicated
preferred_kernels: [flash_attn, triton_fwd, ref_attn]
target_concurrency_per_gpu: 16
autoscale_headroom: 0.35
warm_slots: 1
fallback_policy:
  - q4->q4f32
  - q4f32->fp32
```

Anna Chen: good. Two follow-ups: (1) can we simulate microbursts with the new kernel mix to verify headroom? (2) any region-specific config we should bake into rollout?

Josh Patel: I'll run a 6h microburst sim with traffic patterns from last quarter and the kernel fallback chain. Will post sim results here. Expecting to push updated sizing numbers by EOD tomorrow. :clock1:

Priya Rao: For region-specific, add higher warm_slots in eu-central (2) because cold starts there hit p95 wider. Also set a slightly higher cooldown window for autoscaler to avoid thrash.

bench-bot: Sim plan queued — job id 2026-176555-sim30b. Parameters: 30m steady -> 30s microburst x10, kernel-chain enabled, kv-cache warmup=0.6. Output will include p50/p95, effective tps, and kernel-switch counts.

Anna Chen: Awesome. If sim shows >15% p95 regression under fallback, we'll consider increasing starting GPUs in eu by +1 and pre-warming additional slots. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Josh Patel: noted, will also capture token cost impact (cache hit vs cold) so we can model monthly committed capacity cost delta.

Marco Silva: one more: log kernel-switch events to per-route tracing so we can correlate quality regressions to kernel fallbacks. Small change but high signal.

Anna Chen: added to checklist. I'll wait for sim outputs then propose the Dedicated pool PR.

Priya Rao: LGTM.

Josh Patel: pinging when sims finish.

bench-bot: Job 2026-176555-sim30b started (eta ~4h).
